resources.string: A quiet breathing aid for winding down before sleep.
This is a relaxation aid, not medical treatment for insomnia.
Stop immediately if you feel dizziness, shortness of breath, pain, panic, or discomfort.
Works offline. No account or network connection is needed.
Choose a session length, start while the screen is visible, then turn the display off and follow the gentle cues.
Keep the phone uncovered and in a comfortable position. Do not place it under a pillow or body weight.
Choose a short, default, or extended breathing session.
%1$s session. Follow the gentle cues with natural breathing.
You can turn the screen off now. Keep the phone uncovered and comfortable.
Session complete. Settle into rest at your own pace.
Session stopped. Future cues have been cancelled.
Session interrupted. Future cues have been cancelled.
This device has no usable vibrator, so haptic cues are unavailable.
